text:
maya: Quick draft — we need a concise 'quickpitch' one-pager for enterprise deploy modes (hosted / dedicated / private). Goal: field-ready asset for SDRs & AEs, plus a short benchmark callout for the webinar landing page. cc @carlos @jamie

carlos: Love this. Can we cap it to one page, 4 bullets: security, SLA, cost predictability, rollout controls? Also include 1-2 benchmark numbers for latency and cost per 1k tokens for a common prompt.

jamie: I'll pull perf numbers from the latest runs. Draft callouts: p50 gen latency ~120ms (Dedicated), p95 ~340ms (hosted burst). Cost callout: hosted baseline ~$0.18 / 1k tokens, optimized (batching+quant) ~$0.05 / 1k tokens. I'll annotate confidence levels.

maya: Perfect. Webinar hook idea: "Reducing inference surprises: pick the right deploy mode" — 30-min live with a customer case + demo. Landing page needs: headline, 3 short benefits, 2 benchmark callouts, CTA. For lead routing: route security keywords to field sales & solutions.

olivia: For inbound rules, propose simple deterministic routing so SDRs don't miss hot security leads. Suggest ruleset below, will implement in Intercom / HubSpot: 

```
- tag=security-inbound if keywords: gov, SOC2, FedRAMP, compliance
- tag=private-deploy if mentions: on-prem, VPC, air-gapped
- route=AE if ARR_est >= 50k or company_size >= 1000
- fallback=SDR
```

carlos: Nice. For the one-pager layout: header, 3-line value prop, quick matrix (mode vs. when to pick it), two benchmark tiles (latency + cost), one short customer quote, FAQ (security & SLA bullets), CTA to webinar + contact. Keep it skimmable.

jamie: Also add a short 'what to expect' checklist for engineers: sample prompt, expected latency range, cost knob tips (batch size, quant), recommended model variants. Two soundbites for the webinar: "Predictable SLAs at scale" and "Lower per-token cost without sacrificing quality".

maya: I'll assemble a PDF + a single-page HTML snippet for the landing page. Target publish: EOD Thursday. @olivia can you push the routing rules to staging and send a verification?

olivia: Yep — I'll implement and run tests now. Will post screenshots here once tests pass. :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: routing rules deployed to staging (rule-set id: rs-2024-11-06-01) — tests pending.

olivia: Test payload sent, result: tag=security-inbound, routed to AE queue, webhook status 200. Screenshot uploaded. :white_check_mark: 

maya: Awesome — thanks team. I'll drop the draft one-pager link in 30m and schedule a 30-min review tomorrow 10:00am PT. Link (working draft): https://redwood.example/assets/enterprise-quickpitch-draft.html

carlos: Quick note — add an ops contact line (eng-oncall) and a tiny troubleshooting tip for rollback behavior. Otherwise looks good.

maya: Good call, will add ops contact and a one-liner about graceful fallback (automatic model variant routing). See you at the review. :rocket:
